name: @pie-project/browser
description: pie in a browser tab: the runtime and the WebGPU engine as wasm, driven from the page and spoken to with @pie-project/client

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/pie.mjs src/worker.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:./worker.mjs --external:fs --define:__PIE_WASM__='"./pie_browser_bg.wasm"' --log-level=warning --log-override:duplicate-object-key=silent && cp pkg/pie_browser_bg.wasm dist/
